_comment: Human-owned taxonomy. Order is the assignment order: first match wins in scripts/pipeline.py. Slugs are permanent once published (they become URLs at /categories/<slug>). Retiring a category requires a redirect or delisting notice, never a silent 404. Descriptions render on the category page. Match terms are matched case-insensitively against a haystack of full_name + description + topics. Optional "noindex": true keeps a category page reachable and crawlable but out of the search index and out of sitemap.xml -- set on uncategorized, which is a holding pen rather than a browsable subject.

categories.name: Browser Automation
categories.description: MCP servers that drive browsers, scrape the web, or crawl pages — Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and headless Chromium tooling.

categories.name: Databases
categories.description: MCP servers for relational, document, vector, and time-series databases — Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, BigQuery, and vector stores.

categories.name: Communication
categories.description: MCP servers for chat, email, messaging, and video conferencing — Slack, Discord, Telegram, Gmail, Teams, and Matrix.

categories.name: Finance & Commerce
categories.description: MCP servers for payments, accounting, trading, crypto, and fintech APIs — Stripe, QuickBooks, market data, and blockchain integrations.

categories.name: Storage & Files
categories.description: MCP servers for filesystems, object storage, cloud drives, and document access — local files, S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, and PDF/Excel handling.

categories.name: Design Tools
categories.description: MCP servers for design and diagramming apps — Figma, Canva, Excalidraw, drawio, 3D modeling, CAD, and UI component libraries.

categories.name: Home Automation
categories.description: MCP servers for smart-home platforms and protocols — Home Assistant, HomeKit, Matter, Zigbee, and other physical-device controllers.

categories.name: IoT, Hardware & Robotics
categories.description: MCP servers for embedded devices, microcontrollers, hardware interfaces, and robotics — ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, MQTT, sensor networks, ROS, and drones. Robotics may split into its own category as coverage grows.

categories.name: Gaming & Game Dev
categories.description: MCP servers for game engines, game development, and player-facing gaming tools — Unity, Unreal, Godot, Minecraft, Steam, and Roblox.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: MCP servers for auth, vulnerability scanning, pentesting, secrets management, encryption, and reverse engineering.

categories.name: Monitoring & Observability
categories.description: MCP servers for metrics, logs, traces, APM, and error tracking — Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Sentry, and New Relic.

categories.name: Cloud & DevOps
categories.description: MCP servers for cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code, containers, and deployment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CDN edges.

categories.name: Search & Retrieval
categories.description: MCP servers for web search, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation — Brave, Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, and vector-search backends.

categories.name: Productivity & Knowledge
categories.description: MCP servers for notes, tasks, project management, calendars, wikis, and knowledge bases — Notion, Jira, Linear, Asana, Obsidian, Confluence, and Airtable.

categories.name: Infrastructure & SDKs
categories.description: MCP infrastructure: servers and tooling for building, running, routing, and cataloguing MCP itself — framework libraries and official SDKs, gateways, routers and proxies, installers and desktop managers, and registries listing other servers.

categories.name: AI Media Generation
categories.description: MCP servers for AI-generated image, audio, video, and speech — Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, Whisper, TTS/STT, and video processing.

categories.name: AI Coding Assistants
categories.description: MCP servers built for AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Copilot, and IDE-integrated assistants.

categories.name: AI Agents
categories.description: MCP servers for agent frameworks, agent memory, orchestration, and general agentic infrastructure — LangChain, LangGraph, multi-agent systems, and agent skills.

categories.name: AI Models & Inference
categories.description: MCP servers for LLM providers, model inference, and embeddings — OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, Llama, Mistral, Hugging Face, and embedding APIs.

categories.name: Desktop & OS Automation
categories.description: Desktop automation MCP servers that drive the operating system and connected devices rather than the browser — AppleScript and macOS control, Windows and Linux automation, Android and iOS device control, and computer-use tooling.

categories.name: Social & Content Platforms
categories.description: Social media MCP servers for social networks, publishing platforms, and media feeds — Reddit, X, YouTube, Spotify, RSS readers, Ghost, and the major Chinese platforms including WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Douyin.

categories.name: Developer Tools
categories.description: MCP servers for source hosting, CLIs, testing, linting, and developer workflow — GitHub, GitLab, code quality, terminals, notebooks, and language servers. MCP’s own frameworks, gateways and registries live in Infrastructure & SDKs.

categories.name: Uncategorized
categories.description: MCP servers that did not match any category above. Reviewed weekly — matches migrate into new or existing categories as the taxonomy evolves.
